question.text: Based on molecular orbital theory, the bond order depends on the number of electrons in the bonding and antibonding molecular orbitals. Identify the correct statements about bond order ?

options.text: Can assume any positive or integral or fractional value including zero

solution.text: bond order of a molecule is given by Half the difference between the number of electrons in bonding and antibonding electrons, it can have any positive or integral or fractional value including zero
